title: Bringing a Ridgecrest RxSecure Out-of-Pocket Total into Line with the Pharmacy Record
content:
The true out-of-pocket total held on a Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan enrollment is what every later question about the member's deductible and payment stage is measured against, and it is restated for the contract year from the pharmacy record.

Only what the member or a qualifying third party actually paid counts toward the out-of-pocket total, and never more than the plan's negotiated price recorded for the fill; plan payments, premiums and the late enrollment penalty never count.

## Recording the restated total

The restatement is made with `restate_out_of_pocket_total_a40a5cef`, a tool the agent unlocks and then calls. It replaces the figure the enrollment carries with the one supplied. The enrollment then shows the new total, and the member sees it on their next explanation of benefits.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pdp_enrollment_id` | the reference number of the stand-alone Part D drug plan enrollment whose out-of-pocket total is being restated, read from the member's enrollment record | an identifier |
| `restated_out_of_pocket_total` | the true out-of-pocket total for the contract year that the enrollment is to carry | in USD as a figure of nothing or more rounded to 2 decimal places, half-up at the point of writing; never left empty |

### Return

A confirmation sentence in plain text carrying the drug plan enrollment reference number and the out-of-pocket total the enrollment now holds, in USD. A sentence of this shape means the enrollment carries the new total; any other text means the enrollment was left as it was.
